info.description: HDX HAPI provides humanitarian datasets from the Humanitarian Data Exchange, including affected people, coordination and context, food security, geography, climate, and metadata. This connector supports read-only operations and pagination with limit and offset. Authentication is handled by deriving a Base64 app identifier from the provided app name and email and sending it with each request.
